rationale: diffusion_recon_dcstep_constrained_mayo_v4-claude-agentic: recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/ddpm_mayo_constrained_v4.pt, recon_mode=dps, recon_sample_steps=60, recon_eta=30.0, recon_init=fbp, recon_eta_clamp=False, recon_dcstep_every=5, recon_dcstep_n_cg=3, recon_dcstep_warmup=5, recon_dcstep_relax=1.0, recon_dc_solver=cg, val_n=90, train_n=0, rationale=iter-7 search-20260619-01 CONSTRAINED diff-recon — AUTHORIZED B-fix part (i): raise NFE (finer DDIM grid). ONE HYPOTHESIS KNOB: recon_sample_steps 40->60 (DDIM reverse-step count T); val_n 120->90 is the BUDGET-SIZING co-move (the ONE authorized val_n exception per the B directive — metric evenly-spaces across the 214-slice volume when val_n<214), NOT a second hypothesis. BASE = iter-6 BEST (the LANDED A-fix: recon_dc_solver=cg, T=40, eta=30, relax=1.0, every5/n_cg3/warmup5, val_n=120, SSIM 0.7873/hr0 — run-best). recon_dc_solver=cg HELD (the landed A-fix stays on). TRAJECTORY (val=L277, 321px geometry FOV, LD-FBP floor ~0.81): iter-1 T=25 legacy SSIM 0.3937/hr0; iter-2 eta30->1 0.2366 (regressed, wrong lever); iter-3 relax1.0->0.3 0.2377 (flat, wrong lever); iter-4 T25->28 0.4784; iter-5 T28->40 (val_n214->120) 0.6647; iter-6 DC legacy->cg (A-fix) 0.7873 (BEST). KEY SIGNAL: T is the ONLY live SSIM lever — T 25->28->40 lifted SSIM monotonically 0.394->0.478->0.665, and the corrected CG-DC lifted it further to 0.787 without raising T. The recon sits 0.787 vs the ~0.81 FBP floor; a finer reverse grid is the untested continuation of the one proven lever. FRAMING (per audit): this is regime-bounded on DENSE 2304-view Mayo (LD-FBP near-complete) — a finer DDIM grid will likely NOT clear hr>0 here; its real payoff is the 128-view SPARSE benchmarks + the planned EMA v5 prior. iter-7 VALIDATES the NFE lever runs + measures whether more steps lift SSIM. HYPOTHESIS: if the proven monotone T-lever continues on the corrected CG-DC trajectory, T=60 lifts SSIM above iter-6 0.7873 (toward the ~0.81 FBP floor). NUMERIC FALSIFIER: if SSIM <= 0.7873 (flat/below iter-6) at T=60, the NFE lever has SATURATED on dense Mayo -> B-fix part (i) validated FAITHFUL-BUT-REGIME-BOUNDED (finer grid does not help where LD-FBP is already near-complete; payoff awaits the 128-view sparse benchmarks + EMA v5 prior); constrained best stays iter-6 (SSIM 0.7873, hr 0). hr expected ~0 regardless (regime-bounded). BUDGET: cost linear in T x val_n; per-slice-per-step constant from the CG path = 0.2007 s (iter-6 963.5s/120/40). T=60 x val_n=90 = 60*90*0.2007 = 1084 s = 18.1 min < the HARD 1200s/20-min wall (1800s in-solver backstop + 30-min --time as further backstops). T=60 at val_n=120 would be 1445s=24.1min (BLOWS the wall); val_n=100 would be 1204s=20.1min (too tight) -> val_n=90 is the budget mechanism that gives ~2 min headroom for the CG inner-loop variance. val=90 evenly-spaced L277, 321px detector-geometry FOV default (no fov=False). staged_canonical data, v3 mayo_ldct_fitted geometry, per-sample-ps single-val-ps probe, bg_target=truth, reuse ddpm_mayo_constrained_v4.pt (NO retrain), recon_dc_solver=cg (landed A-fix), 321px FOV.
